mapper.select: /* USE : NaverOrderLinkMapper.getStoreInfo */ SELECT tms.STORE_CD, tms.STORE_NM, tms.OWNER_NM, tms.HQ_OFFICE_CD, tms.BIZ_NO, SUBSTR(tms.BIZ_NO, 0, 3) AS BIZ_NO1, SUBSTR(tms.BIZ_NO, 4, 2) AS BIZ_NO2, SUBSTR(tms.BIZ_NO, 6, 5) AS BIZ_NO3, REGEXP_REPLACE(tms.TEL_NO, '[^0-9]', '') AS TEL_NO, tms.MP_NO, tms.POST_NO, tms.ADDR, tms.ADDR_DTL FROM TB_MS_STORE tms WHERE tms.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND tms.STORE_CD = #{storeCd}
